body: Set B=E(P). The two index applications yield the positive operator budget. On a dense maximal-marginal-rank projection class, saturated Schur complement yields the rectangular resource bound used by operator transport. Supported logarithm tails paid by P<=9B and P<=4C pass the singular limit. For aI+bP, the shifted transport pairs s>=u with t>=t(u)>=4u/3; bound and integrate the missing output interval exactly using H<=8I, whose logarithmic cost equals the available scalar margin. Jensen then bounds the actual derivative of Delta(I+rP), which integrates from0. No scalar layer-cake entropy lift is assumed.
